axis.definition: the acquisition day, one dot per chip; no day of this record carries two chips, so the orbit offset is cosmetic
axis.name: acquisition_day
axis.note: the event falls inside a drawn step, so the two stretches meet at a band and not at a point

coverage_by_orbit.note: both directions straddle the collapse date and the four post-event echo chips are two ascending and two descending passes: this block describes where the echoes sit over the four pass geometries, it is not an orbit contrast of the states

normalisation.base: the median of the pre-event echo-bearing chips, per dimension
normalisation.no_interpolation: the nine steps longer than the cadence are drawn as bands and no line crosses them
normalisation.rule: value / that dimension's own pre-window median

panels.floor_ticks: the echo-free chips, which carry no ordinate at all
panels.scale_rule: P (a bounded pixel frequency) is the only linear panel; gamma2, A, D, F and S are multiplicative mask magnitudes drawn on log axes, as in the KDLO series companion

power.note: 4 of 12 post-event chips carry an echo, so the post-state distribution is drawn from 4 echoes: the collapse contrast of this site is an echo-coverage statement with this caveat attached, not a damage verdict.

provenance.note: the five committed inputs, by content; the same digests the analysis reference names, re-read here and pinned

role: companion: the 6D series of every echo-bearing chip of the record on one dated axis, with the echo-free chips on the panel floor
site: Haltern AV9 Wind Park (Kreis Recklinghausen, NRW)
title: HALTERN — the echo-mask vector over the whole record, the collapse inside the axis
